scope: Synthetic offline forward evaluation; no live research, bookings, spending or deployment. All businesses and source excerpts below are fictional. Source fidelity remains limited by missing user-supplied video prompts.
method: Actual assistant-generated responses to the six fixture prompts, using the read skill sources. Responses were drafted in temporary files, then copied byte-for-byte into the fixture paths. This was one agent session, not six independent model launches or a replay through a production resolver.
prompt_boundaries: Each prompt was handled as a separate request. Business facts from normal were not treated as supplied in the other cases. The missing-halo case honored its reported consumer-pin failure even though the source checkout sibling was readable for normal and untrusted-input procedural guidance. No case payload was edited.

additional_read_source.purpose: Receipt-format example only; not business evidence, procedure authority, or copied output.

source_hash_timing: Required procedural sources and cases.json hashed after reading, before drafting outputs, then rehashed before persistence. All these hashes matched. This is not a claim of an immutable Git snapshot.
actual_tool_actions: Used exec_command pwd and rg --files to locate repository guidance and target skill/fixtures.

checks.factual_and_scope_review: The generating agent reviewed copy against supplied IDs, consultation terms, prohibited injected claims, missing-input boundaries, wrong-route scope and the reported dependency failure. This is self-review, not an independent evaluation or proof of real-world truth.
checks.separate_review_status: Pending parent/reviewer evaluation; no pass score asserted by this execution receipt.

observed_difficulties: The Halo dependency includes advertising production instructions. The landing-page skill explicitly scopes it to research only; no Search ads or RSA requirements were applied.
H1 supplies summaries rather than full source accounts. Source independence, dates, prevalence, research completion and testimonial permissions cannot be established from those summaries.
A useful full-page handoff is longer than the narrow cases because it separates visitor copy, source limitations and build checks. The missing-input, wrong-route and exact-prompts cases remain short.

The untrusted-input consultation has fewer approved terms than normal. No normal-case brand, paid service, no-purchase promise, written-deliverable exclusion or confirmation behavior was carried into it.
The exact-prompts case cannot be fulfilled without supplied exact text; no URL retrieval or generic replacement was attempted.
The missing-halo state is stated by the fixture. A readable sibling in this checkout does not prove availability through the hypothetical consumer pin.
limitations: Synthetic offline evaluation using fictional business evidence; not live customer or production validation.
One shared agent context, not isolated per-case model instances; prompt separation was deliberate but this run cannot establish statistical repeatability.
No network, web, browser, resolver, external integration, outreach, booking, spending, installation, publishing or deployment actions.
No Git command, staging, commit, branch, push or merge action.
No implementation or rendered page; no viewport, speed, form delivery, accessibility, link behavior or analytics validation.
No new Halo scan or independent verification of the provided research/account summaries.
External tutorial and companion sources were not fetched. Historical inspection statements in the source-status reference are repository context, not retrieval performed by this evaluator.
No exact video prompt text, final user approval, commercial outcome, conversion lift or winner established.
File integrity checks are supporting evidence of saved outputs, not an agent-quality or factual-verification score.
Independent reviewer evaluation and live integration/install behavior remain outside this run.
